posts.text: First place 🏆 One real problem solved. The problem hit close to home: everyday Western students (myself included) waste time wandering between libraries and buildings looking for a seat. People were literally posting on Reddit asking where to study. There was no centralized tool. So we built one. SpotUWO is a real time, community powered study space finder for Western's campus.
